g.data-label: D4 · one monotonic virtual clock, and it is the only clock the explicit value in world_state is authoritative — no runtime epoch, no mirrored advance, no conformance assertion against a runtime value this is a correction: pinned --virtual-time prints a banner and changes nothing — now() returns real epoch and sleep blocks for real time timeout is derived from generated completion time against a production deadline, never a freely chosen error label modeled time is free, so determinism no longer trades against gate runtime routing is all-or-nothing within a profile — see dst-hermeticity-detectors

g.data-label: D11 · search is a first-class gate a blocking PR corpus of fixed seeds and promoted regressions, plus a rotating scheduled corpus with a deterministic seed window each declares an operator-accepted minimum the gate asserts exactly — zero, truncated, or below-minimum fails class-reached and branch-reached are separate counters read from D3's catalogue: reaching a fault class is not evidence its production branch ran a promoted failure travels with its manifest, or it is a program nobody can state the meaning of
